[[The Huntsman Path - Secured Perimeter]] |related = |related2 = |reqkappa =Yes }} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''. ==Dialogue== {{quote|I see you're quite a good shot, kid. Sniper said he wants to test your reaction time. The faster one wins, as he says. As in that film, remember, "The Good, the Bad and the Ugly", only with a bolt-action rifle instead of a revolver. Life here certainly isn’t a movie, but the reaction and the choice of position are very important in the firefight, especially in urban conditions. If you survive this, help yourself to my cowboy hat, I have one around here somewhere. You choose yourself, who you want to be: the good, the bad, or the ugly.}} ==Objectives== * Eliminate 3 PMCs from less than 25 meters away while using a [[Weapons#Bolt-action rifles|bolt-action rifle]] ==Rewards== * +10,500 [[EXP]] *[[Jaeger]] Rep '''+0.02''' * 70,000 Roubles ** 73,500 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1 ** 80,500 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2 * 1× [[Mosin Rifle Tacfire Tanker Style 7.62x54R muzzle brake]] * 1× [[Mosin Rifle AIM Sports Recoil Pad]] * Unlocks purchase of [[Mosin Rifle Tacfire Tanker Style 7.62x54R muzzle brake]] at [[Jaeger]] LL2 * Unlocks purchase of [[Mosin Rifle AIM Sports Recoil Pad]] at [[Jaeger]] LL2 * Unlocks craft for [[.366 TKM AP-M]] at [[Hideout#Modules|Workbench level 3]] * Unlocks Colored [[Hideout]] shooting range target style {{quote|You have got a good reaction time since you're still standing here. Grab your new hat, as promised! Go on, shooter, new tests await you.}} ==Guide== To do this quest, grab a [[Weapons#Bolt-action rifles|bolt-action rifle]] or an [[MP-18 7.62x54R single-shot rifle|MP-18]]. [[Factory]] is a recommended location for this quest, as there are ample opportunities to engage PMC's at 25m or closer. You can use the [[Model 7290 Flash Bang grenade|M7290 grenade]], the [[Zarya stun grenade|Zarya grenade]] or a [[KS-23M]] with the [[23x75mm Zvezda flashbang round|Zvezda flashbang round]] to flash and stun PMC'S and make them easier targets. {{Navbox quests}} [[Category:Quests]] [[cs:Střelec z Tarkova - Část 3]] [[fr:"Le tireur de Tarkov" - Partie 3]] [[ru:Тарковский стрелок.
